STAGE 1

Write the whole-module specification

InputClean RTL module: rtlpp_01824_combined.v
InstructionDescribe the whole module’s interface and observable behavior in self-contained prose.

Protocol summary; exact prompt wording is retained by the evaluation runner, not this historical import.

OutputGenerated whole-module specification (prose).
Read input: rtlpp_01824_combined.v · Open raw
module rtlpp_01824(
  input clk,
  input reset,
  input start_i,
  input [3:0] round_i,
  input [127:0] last_key_i,
  output reg [127:0] new_key_o,
  output reg ready_o,
  output reg sbox_access_o,
  output reg [7:0] sbox_data_o,
  input [7:0] sbox_data_i,
  output reg sbox_decrypt_o
);

reg [2:0] next_state;
reg [2:0] state;
reg [7:0] rcon_o;
reg [31:0] next_col;
reg [31:0] col;
reg [127:0] key_reg;
reg [127:0] next_key_reg;
reg next_ready_o;
reg [127:0] K_var, W_var;
reg [31:0] col_t;
reg [23:0] zero;

always @(*)
begin
  case(round_i)
    1: rcon_o = 8'h01;
    2: rcon_o = 8'h02;
    3: rcon_o = 8'h04;
    4: rcon_o = 8'h08;
    5: rcon_o = 8'h10;
    6: rcon_o = 8'h20;
    7: rcon_o = 8'h40;
    8: rcon_o = 8'h80;
    9: rcon_o = 8'h1B;
   10: rcon_o = 8'h36;
   default: rcon_o = 8'h00;
  endcase
end

always @(posedge clk or negedge reset)
begin
  if(!reset) begin
    state <= 0;
    col <= 0;
    key_reg <= 0;
    ready_o <= 0;
  end else begin
    state <= next_state;	
    col <= next_col;
    key_reg <= next_key_reg;
    ready_o <= next_ready_o;
  end
end

always @(*)
begin
  zero = 24'b0;
  col_t = col;
  W_var = 128'b0;
  next_state = state;
  next_col = col;
  next_ready_o = 0;
  next_key_reg = key_reg;
  new_key_o = key_reg;
  sbox_decrypt_o = 0;
  sbox_access_o = 0;
  sbox_data_o = 0;
  K_var = last_key_i;
	
  case(state)
    0: begin
      if(start_i) begin
        col_t = 0;
        sbox_access_o = 1;
        sbox_data_o = K_var[127:120];
        next_state = 1;
      end
    end

    1: begin
      sbox_access_o = 1;
      sbox_data_o = K_var[119:112];
      col_t[7:0] = sbox_data_i;
      next_col = col_t;
      next_state = 2;
    end

    2: begin
      sbox_access_o = 1;
      sbox_data_o = K_var[111:104];
      col_t[31:24] = sbox_data_i;
      next_col = col_t;
      next_state = 3;
    end

    3: begin
      sbox_access_o = 1;
      sbox_data_o = K_var[103:96];	
      col_t[23:16] = sbox_data_i;
      next_col = col_t;
      next_state = 4;
    end

    4: begin
      sbox_access_o = 1;
      col_t[15:8] = sbox_data_i;
      next_col = col_t;
      W_var[127:96] = col_t ^ K_var[127:96] ^ {rcon_o, zero};		
      W_var[95:64]  = W_var[127:96] ^ K_var[95:64];
      W_var[63:32]  = W_var[95:64] ^ K_var[63:32];
      W_var[31:0]   = W_var[63:32] ^ K_var[31:0];
      next_ready_o = 1;
      next_key_reg = W_var;	
      next_state = 0;
    end

    default: begin
      next_state = 0;
    end
  endcase
end

endmodule
